text: Disney operates parks, streaming, sports, and media within a unified corporate structure under CEO Josh D'Amaro. ESPN remains inside Disney, while Disney+ is positioned alongside other business units within an integrated consumer platform. No major separation of business units is under consideration.

meta.note: The source combines operating results and executive statements; classification isolates the stated organizational configuration.

text: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal court to charges related to Brian Thompson's killing and awaits sentencing on Dec. 18. New York murder and firearms charges remain pending while the defense seeks dismissal under state double-jeopardy law.

meta.note: Resolution applies only to the federal case; the status of parallel state charges remains unresolved.
